- runtime `--project repo`: 3 files, 808 tests, all pass;

1. Read the next scheduled full run, 39861781058 on `5801a4f2c9`. If `Test Core (6/6)` is red again, pull the full log from the web UI and name the driver-sqlite-wasm test.
